hypothesis_templates.template: Proteins with {property} in range [{min}, {max}] have significantly {higher/lower} crystallization success rate than the population average
For {organism_class} proteins, optimal crystallization pH is {pH_range} with {precipitant_type}
Expression in {host_system} with {tag_type} at {induction_temp}°C leads to {higher/lower} crystallization success compared to {alternative_system}
Co-crystallization with ligands having Kd < {threshold} nM increases diffraction quality crystal probability by {effect_size}%
Proteins with ESM-2 cosine similarity > {threshold} to a successfully crystallized protein share optimal conditions with probability > {prob}
Surface entropy reduction mutations at positions with high B-factor improve crystallization success rate by {effect_size}%
For proteins with {disorder_percent}% predicted disorder, {NMR/Cryo-EM} yields structure faster than X-ray crystallography
PEG molecular weight {MW} is optimal for proteins in the {MW_range} kDa range, while ammonium sulfate is preferred for {pI_range} pI proteins

pre_generated_hypotheses.hypothesis: Proteins in the 10-30 kDa molecular weight range have the highest crystallization success rate
pre_generated_hypotheses.rationale: Smaller proteins have fewer conformational degrees of freedom, facilitating crystal packing
mcp_query_plan: get_statistics() → confirm total crystallization records
search_crystallization_conditions(outcome=diffraction_quality) → collect successful conditions
search_proteins() → get MW distribution
Statistical binning by MW → chi-squared test
pre_generated_hypotheses.expected_result: 10-30 kDa: ~31% success vs 30-50 kDa: ~28% vs >100 kDa: ~8%

pre_generated_hypotheses.hypothesis: E. coli expression with His6-tag at 18°C induction yields the highest downstream crystallization success
pre_generated_hypotheses.rationale: Low induction temperature promotes proper folding; His6 is minimally disruptive to crystal contacts
mcp_query_plan: get_experiments(type=expression, host=E. coli) → expression records
Cross-reference construct_ids with crystallization outcomes
Group by tag_name × induction_temp → success rates
ANOVA + post-hoc Tukey HSD

pre_generated_hypotheses.hypothesis: The optimal crystallization pH correlates with protein pI: best results at pH = pI ± 1.5
pre_generated_hypotheses.rationale: Proteins near their isoelectric point have reduced solubility, nucleation-favorable
mcp_query_plan: search_proteins() → get pI values
search_crystallization_conditions(outcome=single_crystal|diffraction_quality) → pH values
Calculate |pH - pI| distribution for successes vs failures
Kolmogorov-Smirnov test + effect size
pre_generated_hypotheses.expected_result: |pH - pI| < 1.5 in successful crystals significantly more often

pre_generated_hypotheses.hypothesis: Thermophilic organism proteins crystallize at higher temperatures (25-37°C) with higher success rates than mesophilic proteins
pre_generated_hypotheses.rationale: Thermostable proteins maintain conformational rigidity at elevated temperatures
mcp_query_plan: search_proteins(organism contains 'thermus|thermococcus|pyrococcus|sulfolobus') → thermophile set
Compare crystallization temperature and success distributions
Mann-Whitney U test for temperature difference
Chi-squared for success rate difference
pre_generated_hypotheses.expected_result: Thermophile success rate 40-50% vs mesophile 25-30% at matched conditions

pre_generated_hypotheses.hypothesis: Proteins with ESM-2 similarity > 0.85 to a successfully crystallized protein can adopt the same conditions with >70% probability
pre_generated_hypotheses.rationale: Similar sequences adopt similar folds, requiring similar crystallization environments
mcp_query_plan: esm2_search(protein_id=X, k=20) → similar proteins
For each pair: check if conditions overlap within ±0.5 pH, ±5°C, same precipitant
Binary success at transferred conditions → logistic regression on similarity
ROC curve for similarity threshold determination

pre_generated_hypotheses.hypothesis: Co-crystallization with tight-binding ligands (Kd < 100 nM) increases diffraction-quality crystal probability by >15%
pre_generated_hypotheses.rationale: Ligand binding stabilizes protein conformation, reducing conformational entropy
mcp_query_plan: search_ligands() + get_bindings() → ligands with Kd values
Match to constructs with crystallization outcomes
Compare: with-ligand vs without-ligand success rates
Logistic regression controlling for protein MW and pI
pre_generated_hypotheses.expected_result: Kd < 100 nM: +18-22% success; Kd > 10 µM: +3-5% (not significant)

pre_generated_hypotheses.hypothesis: PEG 3350 at 15-25% w/v is the most broadly effective precipitant across all protein families
pre_generated_hypotheses.rationale: PEG 3350 is the most commonly used precipitant in the PDB
mcp_query_plan: search_crystallization_conditions(precipitant_type='PEG 3350') → success rates
Compare with Ammonium Sulfate, PEG 4000, PEG 8000, MPD
Stratify by protein family (Pfam domain)
Chi-squared with Bonferroni correction
pre_generated_hypotheses.expected_result: PEG 3350 is top-1 in 60-70% of protein families by success count

pre_generated_hypotheses.hypothesis: NMR-characterized proteins (with BMRB assignments) show 15-20% higher crystallization success when conditions match NMR sample pH ± 0.5
pre_generated_hypotheses.rationale: NMR sample conditions indicate protein stability; similar pH promotes folded-state crystallization
mcp_query_plan: search_nmr_experiments() → NMR sample pH values
Match to crystallization conditions via construct_id
Calculate |cryst_pH - nmr_pH| for successes vs failures
Logistic regression with pH_difference as predictor
